bio: Brought volvelles to Europe, visited by god while composing a love song, produced The Abbreviated Art of Finding Truth in trees and circular mechanics.
name: Ramon Llull

pieces.content:
Thanks for coming and
you made it
You made to the Volvelle Social Club
It’s our annual meeting
and thanks for coming

We are moving devices yet
clubs of five are outlawed.
Everyone signs up in a round-robin
and we can’t have a pentagram
So no clubs of five

It’s hot today
Really hot inside
It feels about 72 degrees
Not very good weather
for an annual meeting.

But let’s press on
The heat of our bodies
has made things worse
(The heat) Let’s start.
Add a disc to the Volvelle.

An ionic column and
our volunteers and
partners are energetic. You
look so well I hardly believe it
Like an ionic column

Dearest members note
we begin the program
very energetically.
You can change your mind
If you want you can

When the fifth person joins
You go into hibernation.
It’s imperative that
you sleep until the next
Interested person is found.

At first this was painful
But it’s adventure really
All five of you there and
a sleeping adventure
and not Convening

You will be fine but
things don’t look good though.
It’s sort-of stuck between two.
Just rattle the pin and
Add a disc to the Volvelle please
pieces.readme: The minutes of a group which meets, rotates, meets again.
pieces.title: Social spinning

pieces.content:
Two scapegoats bounded up underneath the footbridge. They locked horns. They ate food—seagrass and walnuts—from each other's mouths. They had tested and chewed through fences opportunistically and were now here. Their left eyes were foggy, like an old person's. The irises of these eyes bloomed. In lieu of any other type of routine, the food that they ate from each other's mouths helped to make their circulatory systems go.

Visitors on the footbridge looked down and could see parts of the scapegoats. The visitors would have liked to repurpose them, but it is tricky to get down where the scapegoats are. The visitors wore white jeans and carried big white plastic bags. The scapegoats were naked.

Each animal with a brain inherits and does work on a four-dimensional taxonomic tree of the available forms of animal and their features. Efforts are underway to externalise these via the use of a neural scanner, grid paper, and a series of printed images of available animals. While the animal—such as a scapegoat—has a circulatory system which is going, the taxonomic tree is oriented on polar coordinates. At the moment that this isn't so, an organisational downward wave rattles through the brain of the animal, restructuring the tree into a proper Cartesian setup. This is felt as a brief thinking-of-all-animals and their features.
pieces.title: Scape goating
